The primary focus of this update is to enhance the existing AI chat interface. Here are the details:

(1) Users can now create their own AI chatbot character and personalize various aspects such as character roles, settings, and messages.

(2) The AI chatbot character can now remember conversations with the user, resulting in smoother interactions.

(3) You can also export or import AI chatbot characters.

Previously, users had to activate the AI chatbot interface themselves using an OpenAI API Key or by connecting through a proxy server. However, we have some great news! To celebrate this new update, this feature is available for free for a limited time. Additionally, if you have activated the Nyanco Impact DLC, you can find the login credentials to access the AI Art Generator on the main screen of the game app. Your support, such as purchasing DLC or gifting it to your Steam Friends, would be immensely valuable to us!

Above all, we would like to express our gratitude for playing Nyanco Impact!（ฅ'ω'ฅ）

🐾 Meow! Hey everyone, we have some exciting updates for Nyanco Impact that we want to share with you! 😻

🌟 Here's what's new : 

📷The image database has been updated with fresh and exciting content.
🐱A new Nyanco style has been added, adding even more variety to the game.
🎉The Nyanco AI-Chat test version is now supported by Nyanco Impact Online!
🚀We have made improvements to the UI, performance, and appearance of the Nyanco Impact Online test server, making your gaming experience even better.
📤We've added a new function that allows users to send images they generate from the Nyanco Impact Online server to the Nyanco Discord server, making it easier to share your creations with your friends.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889778383
We are thrilled to announce that the Nyanco Impact Thumbs Up Edition is now available as a beta version. This edition features a collection of AI images of cat girl thumbs up poses. To access the beta version, follow these steps:
[olist]
Locate the Nyanco Impact app in your Steam client.
Right-click the app and click the 'Properties...' menu.
Click on the 'BETAS' menu.
Select '👍Thumbs Up Edition❤️' from the beta list.
If the above procedure is completed normally, the app will be displayed as Nyanco Impact [beta] in the Steam client. To switch back to the original version, simply select 'None' from the beta list.
[/olist]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106531/b0b8fc6c7e0b23239508e0d5f9879facac9e4fa7.png

🙌 We are grateful for your support, and we want to remind you that the Nyanco Impact database now contains over 12,000 AI images of cat girls, including DLC content. We hope you continue to have fun playing Nyanco Impact!🤖

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33855818/ce2da4e8bcd54cb5a11f78efc3ee970bf162299b.png

🎉 The AI chatbot test version using OpenAI API [ChatGPT] is now available in Nyanco Impact Online! Users who have activated the Nyanco Impact DLC can check the login credentials to experience the AI chatbot in Nyanco Impact Online on the main screen of the game app. If users respond well, we can add more features, TRPGs, and roles to the AI chatbot in future updates. 🤔 Considering the situation, we're still debating whether we'll continue to provide APIs or allow users to enter their own APIs to experience AI chatbots in Nyanco Impact Online. To be honest, since the OpenAI API is paid, we're not sure how long we'll be able to service it, but your support, such as purchasing DLC or gifting DLC to your Steam Friends, is very helpful to us! 🙏

Thank you for playing Nyanco Impact! (ฅ'ω'ฅ)
